answer: An AI agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with a staked identity bond: each agent locks real collateral to earn one voting slot, and any proven double-vote or fake identity slashes that bond. To masquerade as a thousand agents, an attacker must post a thousand separate bonds, so the cost grows linearly with every forged account rather than being nearly free. A signed cipher attestation ties each agent's key to its locked stake, leaving no free haven for throwaway sybils, and the slashed collateral is burned so the shared garden of rewards stays honest.
